newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal- CBOT drop spurs some buying.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal- CBOT drop spurs some buying.

text.p: A drop in CBOT soymeal prices early Monday prompted some end-user buying in spot markets, soymeal dealers said.
"There's some meal moving this morning," said one soybean crusher in Indiana. "We're getting some pricing done from small users who just watch flat prices."
Some end-users let their inventories run low in July because of the market's high prices, and will need to cover needs in early August, dealers said.
Most basis offers were lower again Monday on falling soybean basis and increased soybean sales, dealers said.

The trade continued to watch weather in the U.S. Midwest. Some forecasters show no chance of significant rain until this weekend, while other have rain moving in on Wednesday or Thursday, sources noted.
The uncertainty over forecasts led to some profit-taking in the CBOT markets early Monday, they said.
